Its neck feathers (hackles) are long, pointed, and display a mix of golden-orange and black iridescence. The breast feathers are dark brown/black with some lighter speckling. The beak is yellowish-grey and slightly open. The background consists of blurred green foliage and a white structure, suggesting an outdoor garden setting.
